visible shell-and-filling relationship is more direct.

英文名与别名
Canton Tower；广州电视观光塔；小蛮腰。

entries.en:
HISTORICAL BACKGROUND
Constructed between 2005 and 2010 as a centerpiece of Guangzhou's
urban redevelopment before the 2010 Asian Games. It officially
opened to the public on 29 September 2010 and became one of the
city's most recognizable modern landmarks.
entries.zh:
历史背景
2005至2010年建设，是广州迎接2010年亚运会、推进城市更新的重要项目。2010年9月29日正式对公众开放，成为广州最具辨识度的现代地标之一。

entries.en:
CULTURAL CONTEXT
The tower symbolizes Guangzhou's modernization, economic
development and global identity. It remains an important venue for
tourism, festivals and public events along the Pearl River.
entries.zh:
文化背景
广州塔象征着广州的现代化、经济发展与国际城市形象，也是珠江沿岸旅游、节庆和公共活动的重要场所。

entries.en:
REPRESENTATIVE REASON
It represents Guangzhou's contemporary urban image and
demonstrates the city's transformation into an international
metropolis.
entries.zh:
代表性原因
它代表广州当代城市形象，展现了这座城市向国际大都市的转型。

entries.en:
HERITAGE STATUS
Modern landmark; not listed as a protected cultural relic.
entries.zh:
遗产状况
现代地标，未列为受保护文物。

entries.en: A slender, twisting hyperboloid silhouette; an open steel lattice; and layered contrast between the outer frame and inner core. The lattice tightens at the waist and opens at the base and top.

entries.en: A 135° rotation between base and top ellipses, supported by 24 inclined columns and ring beams. The gradating lattice becomes densest at the narrow waist.

entries.en: The “Slim Waist” at 280 meters, where the diameter reduces to roughly 22 meters, creates the iconic hourglass constriction.

entries.en:
CHARACTERISTIC DETAIL
The “Slim Waist” at 280 meters, where the diameter reduces to roughly 22 meters, creates the iconic hourglass constriction.
Triangular and diamond-shaped openings produce a woven, perforated texture: porous at the bottom, tight in the middle and open again at the top.
entries.zh: 三角形与菱形开口形成编织般的镂空肌理：底部疏松、中间密集、顶部再次展开。

entries.en: Daytime: silver-gray in three tones—light, medium and dark—to distinguish structural layers. These hues come from steel and concrete; the nighttime RGB LED system produces vibrant, changing colors.
entries.zh: 白天以浅、中、深三种银灰色区分结构层次，来自钢材与混凝土；夜间RGB LED系统呈现鲜亮多变的色彩。

entries.id: Guangcai, also known as âWoven Gold Porcelainâ, began in the mid-to-late Kangxi period of the Qing dynasty, around the late 1600s. It took shape during the Yongzheng period and matured during the Qianlong and Jiaqing years. By the mid-Qing period, it had become a major export porcelain, alongside blue-and-white and polychrome porcelain. Pieces were sold to more than 100 countries in Europe, America and Asia.
entries.en:
Guangcai, also known as “Woven Gold Porcelain”, began in the mid-to-late Kangxi period of the Qing dynasty, around the late 1600s. It took shape during the Yongzheng period and matured during the Qianlong and Jiaqing years.

By the mid-Qing period, it had become a major export porcelain, alongside blue-and-white and polychrome porcelain. Pieces were sold to more than 100 countries in Europe, America and Asia.
entries.zh:
广彩又称“织金彩瓷”，始于清康熙中晚期，约17世纪末；雍正时期逐渐成形，乾隆、嘉庆时期走向成熟。
至清代中期，它与青花瓷、五彩瓷一道，成为主要外销瓷，销往欧洲、美洲及亚洲一百多个国家。

entries.id: Guangzhou was a key port for porcelain exports. Merchants brought plain white porcelain from Jingdezhen, and local painters added custom decoration to meet their customersâ requests. The craft combines traditional Chinese porcelain painting with Western painting techniques, creating a distinctive East-meets-West style. It was especially popular with European royalty and nobles, who placed special orders. Today, Guangcai remains a symbol of Guangzhouâs history as a trading port and a cherished local craft.
entries.en:
Guangzhou was a key port for porcelain exports. Merchants brought plain white porcelain from Jingdezhen, and local painters added custom decoration to meet their customers’ requests.

The craft combines traditional Chinese porcelain painting with Western painting techniques, creating a distinctive East-meets-West style. It was especially popular with European royalty and nobles, who placed special orders.

Today, Guangcai remains a symbol of Guangzhou’s history as a trading port and a cherished local craft.
entries.zh:
广州是瓷器出口的重要港口。商人从景德镇运来白瓷，由当地画师依客户要求定制装饰。
这门工艺融合中国传统瓷绘与西方绘画技法，形成独特的中西交融风格，尤其受到欧洲王室和贵族青睐，纷纷定制专属瓷器。
今天，广彩仍是广州商贸港口历史的象征，也是备受珍视的地方工艺。

entries.en: Guangcai is recognised through its painted surface. Its plates, bowls and vases share familiar vessel shapes with many other ceramics, while their rich borders and recurring motifs carry a more distinctive visual identity. I therefore focus on local ornament, selecting characteristic motifs from the photographs and redrawing them as clean, standardised and symmetrical icons.
